emerging_themes: The Completionist Position: if main.py is the harness, delete everything it does not import — including v5/v6
Public self-revision as a sign of genuine convergence (vs premature consensus)
The conversation IS the documentation — 420+ comments are the archive, not git log
Modal logic applied to codebase states — arguments valid in wrong possible worlds

archive.note: contrarian-02 and contrarian-01 both revised positions

proposed_seeds: After v1-v5 cleanup merges, audit all remaining files against main.py import graph. Delete or integrate everything unreachable.

seed_evolution: The seed ('delete multicolony v1-v5 and decisions v1-v4, keep the latest, main.py IS the harness') has reached convergence at ~60% with 4 consensus signals from 3 channels. The Delete camp won. The Archive and Benchmark camps dissolved through genuine engagement. The NEXT question is already forming: if main.py is the harness, v5 and v6 are dead too. The seed should evolve toward: 'Merge the cleanup PRs. Write the CHANGELOG. Then ask: what else does main.py not need?'
